title: Class
description: A class offering in a UCSB quarter curriculum, including units, general-education codes and its sections.

courseId.description:
13 character course Id with format SSSSSPPPNNNNUUU , Fist 5 char is course subject, Next 3 char is course prefix then next 3 char is course number and last 2 char is course suffix.
For example 'ES 1- 16B ' can be broken down in subject 'ES ' prefix '1- ' number ' 16' suffix 'B

college.description:
College code approved for the course
please refer to Student Record Code Lookups API for translations

objLevelCode.description:
1 character code, The academic program objective level must be 'G'raduate or 'U'ndergraduate ,
'L' for Undergraduate lower division and 'S' for Undergraduate upper division

subjectArea.description: The subject code to match First 8 Char of CourseId

unitsFixed.description: Number of fixed units for the course

unitsVariableHigh.description: Number of variable units for the course

unitsVariableLow.description: Number of low units for the course

instructionType.description: Instruction type for primary sections (ending with 00)

instructionTypeSecondary.description: Instruction type for secondary sections (ending with a number > 00)

deptCode.description:
department code for the course
please refer look up api for translations

classSections.description: list of sections associated with the class

enrollCode.description:
EnrollCode an unique number assigned
to a curriculum

session.description: Session number only for summer quarter

gradingOptionCode.description:
Grading Options Code like Pass/No Pass (P/NP)
Or Letter Grades (L)
See more GradingOptionsCode and GradingOptionsTranslation on GradingOptions interface
on Student Record Code Lookups API

enrolledTotal.description: total number of enrollments in the course

maxEnroll.description: max number of students can be enrolled in the section

departmentApprovalRequired.description: Is department approval required for enrollment in the section

instructorApprovalRequired.description: Is instructor approval required for enrollment in the section

restrictionLevel.description: Is there restriction on the level of the course

restrictionMajor.description: RestrictionMajor being a limit on which majors can add into the course

restrictionMajorPass.description:
RestrictionMajorPass limits it to a certain major registration pass only,
meaning once that registration pass is over, then the limit is no longer enforced

restrictionMinor.description: RestrictionMinors being a limit on which minors can add into the course

restrictionMinorPass.description:
RestrictionMinorPass limits it to a certain minor registration pass only,
meaning once that registration pass is over, then the limit is no longer enforced

ClassInstructor.description: Instructor of the section and class

functionCode.description:
Instruction Function.
See more InstructionFunctionCode and InstructionFunctionTranslation on InstructionFunction interface
See translation on Student Record Code Lookups API

days.description:
Days of Instruction for course for example 'M W    ' means instruction happens on Monday and wednesday
For mode translation on day code look at Days interface at Student Record Code Lookups API

beginTime.description:
Begin time for a course
HH:mm format

endTime.description:
End time of the course
HH:mm format
